title: CANVAS
subtitle: TRCOLORI SQUADRON // PAINT SHOP
lore: Upstart ace on the way to fame, CANVAS's flying career was cut short when her aircraft took a direct hit from ground fire, severely damaging multiple sections and afflicting a near-fatal injury to the pilot.

She was permenantly grounded from combat roles due to her injury, leaving her plane in a slight state of disrepair afterwards. However, CANVAS found her calling in painting aircraft for fellow mercenaries.

CANVAS would attain LEGIONNAIRE status after opening the TRICOLORI PAINT SHOP, giving pilots of the DML an accessible and reliable one-stop-shop for all aircraft customization needs, from a simple emblem repaint to entirely new and wild aerobatic liveries.
